troc.translation: abbr. tactical satellite relay operations center 战术卫星中继操作中心

trocadero.translation: 特罗卡迪罗（巴黎著名广场名）

trocar.definition:
n. A stylet, usually with a triangular point, used for
   exploring tissues or for inserting drainage tubes, as in dropsy.
trocar.translation:
n. 套管针
[医] 套针

trochaic.definition: a of or consisting of trochees
trochaic.translation:
n. 扬抑格诗句
a. 扬抑格的, 长短格的

trochanter.definition: n. one of the bony prominences developed near the upper extremity of the femur to which muscles are attached
trochanter.translation: [医] 转子(解剖); 转节(昆虫)

trochanteric.definition: a. Of or pertaining to one or both of the trochanters.

trochantine.definition:
n. The second joint of the leg of an insect, -- often
   united with the coxa.

troche.definition: n a medicated lozenge used to soothe the throat
troche.translation:
n. 药片, 片剂
[医] 锭剂, 糖锭

trochee.definition: n. a metrical unit with stressed-unstressed syllables
trochee.translation: n. 扬抑格, 长短格

trochili.definition:
n. pl. A division of birds comprising the humming birds.
pl.  of Trochilus
trochili.translation: n. 蜂雀, 任何善鸣的小鸟

trochilic.definition:
a. OF or pertaining to rotary motion; having power to draw
   out or turn round.

trochilics.definition: n. The science of rotary motion, or of wheel work.

trochilus.definition:
n. A genus of humming birds. It Formerly included all the
   known species.
n. Any one of several species of wrens and kinglets.
n. The crocodile bird.
n. An annular molding whose section is concave, like the
   edge of a pulley; -- called also scotia.

troching.definition: n. One of the small branches of a stag's antler.
troching.translation: n. 【药物】锭剂, 糖锭剂, 片剂

trochiscus.definition: n. A kind of tablet or lozenge; a troche.

trochite.definition: n. A wheel-like joint of the stem of a fossil crinoid.

trochiterian.translation: [医] 大转子的; 肱骨大结节的

trochlea.definition:
n. A pulley.
n. A pulley, or a structure resembling a pulley; as, the
   trochlea, or pulleylike end, of the humerus, which articulates with the
   ulna; or the trochlea, or fibrous ring, in the upper part of the orbit,
   through which the superior oblique, or trochlear, muscle of the eye
   passes.

trochlear.definition: n. either of the two cranial nerves on either side that control the superior oblique muscles of the eyes
trochlear.translation:
a. 滑车的
[医] 滑车的; 滑车神经的

trochlearis.translation: [医]滑车的，滑车神经，滑轮状的，眼上斜肌

trochocephalus.translation: [医] 轮状头畸胎, 圆头畸胎

trochogingiymus.translation: [医] 车轴屈戍关节(如肱桡关节)

trochoid.definition:
n. The curve described by any point in a wheel rolling on a
   line; a cycloid; a roulette; in general, the curve described by any
   point fixedly connected with a moving curve while the moving curve
   rolls without slipping on a second fixed curve, the curves all being in
   one plane. Cycloids, epicycloids, hypocycloids, cardioids, etc., are
   all trochoids.
a. Admitting of rotation on an axis; -- sometimes applied to
   a pivot joint like that between the atlas and axis in the vertebral
   column.
a. Top-shaped; having a flat base and conical spire; -- said
   of certain shells.
a. Of or pertaining to the genus Trochus or family
   Trochidae.
trochoid.translation:
n. 次摆线, 车轴关节
a. 车轴状的

trochoid joints.translation: [医] 车轴关节, 旋转关节

trochoidal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a trochoid; having the properties
   of a trochoid.
a. See Trochoid, a.

trochometer.definition:
n. A contrivance for computing the revolutions of a
   wheel; an odometer.

trochosphere.definition:
n. A young larval form of many annelids, mollusks, and
   bryozoans, in which a circle of cilia is developed around the anterior
   end.

trochotron.translation: n. [电子]电子转换器,磁旋管,余摆管

trochus.definition:
n. Any one of numerous species of marine univalve shells
   belonging to Trochus and many allied genera of the family Trochidae.
   Some of the species are called also topshells.

trocimine.translation: 八氢三甲基苯酰基氮杂环辛四烯

troclosene potassium.translation: [化] 曲氯新钾; 三氯三嗪三酮钾
